title: Forward derived-couple map on filtered representatives
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and U=(K,F) a finite filtered cochain complex [def-sp-filtration]. Let X be its homology exact couple [def-sp-filtered-homology-exact-couple] and T its canonical tower [def-sp-convergence]. Suppose families j_s and t_s map the filtered cycle subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] into graded-complex cycles and T.Z, with j_s iCycles equal to the cycle-subobject inclusion and t_s T.Z.arrow EIso.hom=j_s homologyπ. Let I_n:pageCouple(n).D(P,Q)->X.D(P,Q) be monic, I_0=id and I_(n+1)=derivedDInclusion followed by I_n. For s natural and p,q integers put p'=p+s+1, q'=q-s, P=2p'+q', Q=-p', n'=p'+q'=p+q+1. Let e:X.D(P,Q)->pageCouple(s).D(P-s,Q+s) satisfy e followed by I_s=alphaIter_s. For any object A, a:A->F^p K in degree p+q, b:A->cycles(F^p' K,n'), and x:A->Z_(s+1)^(p,q), assume that da is the ambient inclusion of b and x's graded inclusion is a's graded projection. Then x followed by t_s, T.projection, page f and the equality transport to page D(P-s,Q+s) equals b followed by homologyπ, the equality transport to X.D(P,Q), and e. This is an identity into the derived D object before applying g.

proof.text: Induct on the page number. At zero use the identity projection and hI0. At a successor use projection_succ, hIs, the derived-f restriction equation and cycleLift_comm. This gives projection followed by page f followed by I equals the original cycle inclusion followed by original f. This is the generic calculation also used privately in FiniteCycleFormula.

Unfold the filtered exact couple: the original f, conjugated by the initial homology isomorphism, is the connecting map of F^(p+1) into F^p onto gr^p. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.δ_eq with the supplied graded cycle x followed by j and lift a. The equation ha identifies its differential with the inclusion of the cycle b. Thus the result is the class of b under the homology map of F^(p+s+1) into F^(p+1).

Induct on s, using functoriality of homologyMap and the composition law for subobject inclusions, to identify alphaIter with the homology map of the same filtration inclusion. The equation he now identifies the right-hand side after I with the computed connecting class. Cancel the monomorphism hImono. Integer arithmetic identifies the degrees and the equality transports.

theorem filteredHomology_tower_forward_representatives
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
    (j : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).cycles (p + q))
    (tQ : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
          s (2 * p + q) (-p) : C))
    (hj : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).iCycles (p + q) =
        (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1)).arrow)
    (ht : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      tQ s p q ≫
          ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
            s (2 * p + q) (-p)).arrow ≫
          (filteredHomologyEIso U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration p q).hom =
        j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homologyπ (p + q))
    (I : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : ℤ),
      ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple n).D P Q ⟶
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).D P Q)
    (hI0 : ∀ P Q : ℤ, I 0 P Q = 𝟙 _)
    (hIs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : ℤ), I (n + 1) P Q =
      ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple n).derivedDInclusion
        P Q ≫ I n P Q)
    (hImono : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : ℤ), Mono (I n P Q))
    (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ)
    (e : (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).D
        (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) (-(p + (s + 1))) ⟶
      ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).D
        (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1) - s) (-(p + (s + 1)) + s))
    (he : e ≫ I s (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1) - s)
        (-(p + (s + 1)) + s) =
      (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).alphaIter s
        (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) (-(p + (s + 1))))
    (A : C)
    (a : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.step p : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (p + q))
    (b : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1)) : CochainComplex C ℤ).cycles
      (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)))
    (x : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C))
    (ha : a ≫ (U.obj.filtration.step p).arrow.f (p + q) ≫
        U.obj.obj.d (p + q) (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) =
      b ≫ (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1)) : CochainComplex C ℤ).iCycles
        (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) ≫
          (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1))).arrow.f
            (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)))
    (hx : x ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1)).arrow =
      a ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q)) :
    x ≫ tQ s p q ≫
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.projection
          s (2 * p + q) (-p) ≫
        ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).f
          (2 * p + q) (-p) ≫
        eqToHom (show
          ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).D
              (2 * p + q + 2) (-p - 1) =
            ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).D
              (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1) - s)
              (-(p + (s + 1)) + s) by congr 1 <;> omega) =
      b ≫ (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1)) : CochainComplex C ℤ).homologyπ
          (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) ≫
        eqToHom (by
          change (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1)) : CochainComplex C ℤ).homology
              (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) =
            (U.obj.filtration.step (-(-(p + (s + 1)))) : CochainComplex C ℤ).homology
              (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1) + -(p + (s + 1)))
          rw [neg_neg]
          congr 1; omega) ≫ e
